        Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => services.AddVertexAIEmbeddingGenerator("model", bearerTokenProvider, "location", "project"));
    }

    }

    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVertexAIEmbeddingGenerator_WithBearerTokenProvider_RegistersKeyedServiceAndCallsGetService()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(loggerFactory);
        var bearerTokenProvider = () => new ValueTask<string>("token");

        Assert.Equal(ServiceLifetime.Singleton, descriptor.Lifetime);

        // Verify the factory was called and GetService<ILoggerFactory> was used by checking resolution succeeds
        var embeddingGenerator = provider.GetKeyedService<IEmbeddingGenerator<string, Embedding<float>>>(descriptor.ServiceKey!);
        Assert.NotNull(embeddingGenerator);
